question: The Indian constitution borrowed 'procedure of amending the constitution' from the constitution of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The procedure of amending the constitution** has been adopted from the constitution of **South Africa.**
 
• Things that we have adopted from the** France constitution are Republic and Ideals of Liberty, Equality and Fraternity in the Preamble.**
 
• Things that we have adopted from the** German constitution are Suspension of fundamental rights during an emergency.**
 
• Things that we have adopted from the **Japanese constitution are Procedure established by law.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 __Source__
 __Features Borrowed__
 
 

 Australia
 
 
 
• Joint-sitting of the two Houses of Parliament
 
• Concurrent list
 
• Freedom of trade, commerce, and intercourse
 
 
 
 

 Ireland
 
 
 
• Directive Principles of State Policy
 
• Method of election of the president
 
• Nomination of members to Rajya Sabha
 
 
 
 

 Britain
 
 
 
• Single Citizenship
 
• Cabinet system
 
• Prerogative writs
 
• Parliamentary government
 
• Rule of Law
 
• Bicameralism
 
 
 
 

 US
 
 
 
• Impeachment of the president
 
• Removal of Supreme Court and High Court judges
 
• Independence of judiciary
 
• Judicial review
 
• Fundamental rights
 
• Post of vice-president
 
 
 
 

 Canada
 
 
 
• Appointment of state governors by the Centre
 
• Advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
 
• Federation with a strong Centre
 
• Vesting of residuary powers in the Centre
 
 
 
 

 Japan
 
 
 
• Procedure Established by law
 
 
 
 

 Soviet Union (now, Russia)
 
 
 
• Fundamental duties
 
• Ideals of justice in the Preamble
 
 
 
 

 Germany
 
 
 
• Suspension of Fundamental Rights during emergency
 
 
 
 

 France
 
 
 
• Ideals of liberty, equality, and fraternity in the Preamble
 
 
 
 

 South Africa
 
 
 
• Election of members of Rajya Sabha
 
• Procedure for amendment in the Indian Constitution
